speaker: Doctor
text: I see a newborn with respiratory distress; since you are an infant, I will need to ask your parents for details. How long has your baby been having trouble breathing, and were there any complications during delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
